items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I remember one time Fletcher played a battle of music. I'd like to insert this. Against the Casa Loma Band.

ctx.x: So this was his pattern. Everybody knows Smack is an easy going guy, and the greatest harm he ever did to anybody was to himself by being too easy with these guys. But anytime he had a battle of musical jazz,

he didn't worry. I remember one time Fletcher played a battle of music. I'd like to insert this. Against the Casa Loma Band. This happened in Michigan. And this is a funny thing. He was quite a judge of what we call battling with bands, you know. Okay, this happened in the Greystone Ballroom too. That was a prominent place in the old days, you know, for different things. Well, anyway, there was a band on that side -- Glen Gray Casa Loma Band, two bandstands -- Fletcher on the other side.
So here's Glen Gray and his band, and he had great musicians in that band, you know, --
